title: Running Commentary on Torah 43 — Diburim
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

beginner.en: **"Know: **diburim of a rasha who is a bar da'as generate ni'uf in the listener**. For **zivugim are drawn from da'as** — **'v'ha'adam yada es Chavah ishto'** (Bereshis 4:1); **'kol ishah yoda'as ish'** (Bamidbar 31:17). 2 kinds of zivug: (1) **zivug d'kedushah** = **hiskashrus to tzaddikim, to Torah, to Hashem** — drawn from **da'as d'kedushah**. (2) **Zivugim of aveirah** = drawn from **da'as d'klipah**. **Dibbur is the hisgalus of da'as** — one cannot know what's in another's da'as except through his dibbur — **'ein omer v'ein devarim, bli nishma kolam'** (Tehillim 19:4). Therefore **diburim of the rasha-bar-da'as carry da'as-klipah → plant ni'uf-zivug in the listener's da'as**. All the more important: **'Va'el rasha amar Elokim, mah lecha l'saper chukai'** (Tehillim 50:16) — **keep his mouth away from the words of Torah**, because they would carry the klipah-da'as outward even more effectively."**

intermediate.en: **Diburim of rasha/bar da'as generate ni'uf in listener**. Zivug drawn from da'as (Ber 4:1 "yada"; Bam 31:17). 2 zivugim: **d'kedushah** (hiskashrus tzaddikim/Torah/Hashem, from da'as d'kedushah) + **aveirah** (da'as d'klipah). Dibbur=hisgalus da'as (Teh 19:4 "ein omer... bli nishma kolam"). Hence rasha's dibbur plants ni'uf-da'as in listener. "Va'el rasha amar... mah lecha l'saper chukai" (Teh 50:16) — keep from Torah.
intermediate.he: **דיבורי רשע/בר־דעת מולידים ניאוף בשומע**. זיווג מדעת (בר' ד, א "ידע"; במ' לא, יז). ב' זיווגים: **קדושה** (התקשרות צדיקים/תורה/ה', מדעת קדושה) + **עבירה** (דעת קליפה). דיבור=התגלות דעת (תה' יט, ד "אין אומר... בלי נשמע קולם"). לכן דיבורי הרשע שותלים דעת־ניאוף. "ולרשע אמר... מה לך לספר חוקי" (תה' נ, טז) — למונעו מתורה.

scholarly.he: בר' ד, א; במ' לא, יז; תה' יט, ד; נ, טז.
